units: <cite ref="Mishnah Bava Metzia 9:13">B. Mets. IX, 13</cite> <he>החובל את הר׳ עובר וכ׳</he> he who takes a mill to pledge violates a prohibitory law, and is guilty of taking two vessels &c.; <he>ולא ר׳ ורכב בלבד וכ׳</he> and not only mill and upper millstone are meant (<cite ref="Deuteronomy 24:6">Deut. XXIV, 6</cite>), but anything with which a living is made &c.
<cite ref="Mishnah Menachot 10:4">Men. X, 4</cite>, a. e., v. <cite ref="C01305"><he>גָּרוֹסָה</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Mishnah Beitzah 2:9">Bets. II, 9</cite>, v. <cite ref="Q01117"><he>פִּלְפָּל</he></cite> <cite ref="Tosefta Bava Batra 3:2">Tosef. B. Bath. III, 2</cite>; Y. ib. IV, 14ᶜ bot. <he>ר׳ התחתונה</he> the lower (stationary) millstone (for crushing olives); <he>ר׳ העליונה</he> the upper millstone. Ohol. VIII, 3 <he>הר׳ של אדם</he> a mill worked by man, handmill.

<cite ref="Tosefta Bava Batra 9:2">Tosef. ib. IX, 2</cite> <he>נדחק בר׳ שהגוי וכ׳</he> if a person is pressed to work at a mill where there is a gentile or a menstruant; <he>איזו היא הר׳ כל שעוקרין אותה וכ׳</he> (not <he>כל שאין עוקרין</he>, v. R. S. to Ohol. VIII, 3) what kind of a mill is meant? Such as can be lifted or pushed from its place; <cite ref="Tosefta Tahorot 6:11">Tosef. Toh. VI, 11</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Kiddushin 29b:6">Kidd. 29ᵇ</cite> <he>ר׳ בצוארו</he> he has a millstone on his neck (has wife and children to support).
